Krasyliv Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytska oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is the older of Krasyliv's two Jewish cemeteries, a companion record to the town's separately documented New cemetery elsewhere in this collection. According to resident testimony from a local named Scheinman, the old cemetery existed and was closed in the early 20th century; only a single gravestone believed to be from this cemetery has been found, and it turned up on an abandoned Polish cemetery rather than at this site itself. It served the same community, tied to a Hasidic lineage continued by Rabbi Baruch Zak before his emigration to Palestine, and once numbering over 2,500 people at its 1897 peak.
